avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer that significantly reduces niraparib plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements if mood support needed

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase thrombotic risk; niraparib already carries bleeding risk from bone marrow suppression
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; maintain dietary vitamin K consistency

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase niraparib exposure; effect typically minor but variable
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased side effects; dose adjustment may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition; may modestly increase niraparib levels
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; report any increased toxicity to provider

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases niraparib bioavailability and peak concentrations, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products; switch to alternative citrus fruits

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase niraparib absorption and delay gastric clearance; food effect is modest but notable
caution_foods.action: Take niraparib consistently with or without food; maintain routine for consistency

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cabbage, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contain indole-3-carbinol, weak CYP3A4 inducer; minimal clinical impact but worth noting
caution_foods.action: No need to restrict; maintain normal dietary intake

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of increased toxicity (myelosuppression, GI effects) if CYP3A4 inhibitors are coadministered or consumed. Counsel patients to maintain consistent meal timing relative to niraparib dosing and report any significant changes in tolerability.
